answer_2.quote: Table presents the text simplification results on two benchmark datasets, Newsela-auto and Wikipedia-auto, where we improve the SARI score by 0.9 and 0.6, respectively. The SARI score averages the F1/precision of n-grams inserted (add), kept (keep) and deleted (del) when compared to human references. We also calculate the BLEU score with respect to the input (s-BL), the percentage of new words (%new) added, and the percentage of system outputs being identical to the input (%eq) to show the paraphrasing capability.
